data: Tesla's total revenue was about $96.77 billion in fiscal 2023. In fiscal 2025 it was roughly $94.8 billion, based on my recollection of the company's reported results. That is a decline of about 2.0%, or roughly $2 billion. I haven't checked the fiscal 2025 figure against a current filing, so please confirm it against Tesla's 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 before relying on it.
